name: @polymarket-bot/capital-allocator
description: Capital allocator (WP-180): commitment accounting where open orders and positions both consume limits, per-scope exposure tracking (global/instance/market/series/underlying/resolution-window), user-defined caps with zero-defaulted live-micro caps, reservation lifecycle, and v1 one-live-owner conflict rejection with independent shadow accounting. Pure layer-1 logic: no I/O, no clock, no network, no credential surface.
